request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Recolour only the armour: the helm, pauldrons, arm guards and breastplate become lighter weathered iron, mid grey #7a7f88 with #4a4d55 shadows and a few rust-brown patches, lightest on their left sides; the crown and the armour rims stay tarnished bronze. Add a thin bright violet trim along the hem of the mail skirt. Do not redraw anything else: keep the violet eye slits, greataxe, bone hands and feet, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
